desc: Confirm theoretically that answer <= side: for D>side at most one point per side, so k>=4 forces 4 distinct sides, and the four adjacent-side Manhattan gaps sum to exactly 4*side, giving D<=side. Hence answer always in [0, side].
Confirm that for D<=side, Manhattan>=D is equivalent to the shorter circular perimeter gap>=D, so the problem reduces to circular max-min dispersion.
Implement perimeter coordinate mapping t (corner-consistent order), sort t, and build doubled array T of length 2n.
Implement feasible(D) with a two-pointer next-pointer array over T, binary lifting for O(n log k) checks, requiring pos<s+n and a wrap gap (T[s]+4*side)-T[pos]>=D.
Binary search the maximum feasible D over [0, side] and return it.
Verify against the three provided samples (2, 1, 1) and extra stress cases; all reported PASS.
